items.title: Founder Dipke's birthday tribute to detained co-convener Ashutosh Ranka
items.summary: Abhijeet Dipke posted on Instagram @abhijeetdipke (2:40 PM PDT / 8:10 PM IST Oct 13, ~5.3K likes): a birthday tribute to CJP co-convener Ashutosh Ranka, 'spending your birthday in detention' — recalling the Oct 10 detention and court appearance ('We will do whatever you decide') and writing 'they can detain a person, but they can never detain the courage and conviction that person carries.' Confirms Ranka still in detention at Jaffarpur Kalan on Oct 13 evening. First logged post from the founder since his return to Hingoli; no new facts beyond the continued-detention confirmation and the tribute itself.
